an3.10:1.1: Tīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato tayo male appahāya yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
an3.10:1.3: Dussīlo ca hoti, dussīlyamalañ c' assa appahīnaṃ hoti,
an3.10:1.4: issukī ca hoti issāmalañ c' assa appahīnaṃ hoti,
an3.10:1.5: maccharī ca hoti maccheramalañ c' assa appahīnaṃ hoti.
an3.10:1.6: Imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi dhammehi samannāgato ime tayo male appahāya yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ niraye.
an3.10:2.1: Tīhi bhikkhave dhammehi samannāgato tayo male pahāya yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge.
an3.10:2.3: Sīlavā ca hoti dussīlyamalañ c' assa pahīnaṃ hoti,
an3.10:2.4: anissukī ca hoti issāmalañ c' assa pahīnaṃ hoti,
an3.10:2.5: amaccharī ca hoti maccheramalañ c' assa pahīnaṃ hoti.
an3.10:2.6: Imehi kho bhikkhave tīhi dhammehi samannāgato ime tayo male pahāya yathābhataṃ nikkhitto evaṃ sagge. 11.
